adaptations: Fixed source interval format s/m/h/d and minimum 60 seconds retained; reject unsafe native integer ranges.

Create recurring tasks with inert native marker plus exact owner row. Explicit fire_immediately:true admits one controlled initial child; default false. durable:true is refused before native creation. Both fields are ignored on update, matching source create-only semantics.

Interval updates preserve the creation or last-dispatch anchor; an already-due revised target is postponed by one full interval from update time, matching fixed actor.rs. Prompt-only edits keep the target and reset the next child transcript; cadence alone retains the chain.

Original public create rejects hidden recurring:false despite legacy actor support; authorized host extension supplies native after_seconds, no recurring TTL, and explicitly refuses immediate one-shot execution.

Recurring expiry remains creation+7d, including intervals longer than the TTL. Matching native records are conditionally removed in the native FIFO without activating the parent or terminating accepted children. A changed marker/rule is retained and fenced. Actual deletion receipts persist across restart; UNKNOWN outcomes are never automatically repeated.

Successful proven chain iterations are 1 through 10, then fresh 1 with at most 600 Unicode-code-point summary plus ellipsis. Changed prompt/policy or missing durable transcript/interface proof starts a fresh or explicit fallback chain without unverified summary.

DSH resumes the same child with a new run ID; source creates a new child with resume_from. The host-only continuation seam is not a public Service operation. Missing capability/proof falls back fresh; no claim of identity equivalence.
Accepted inbox message ID is distinct from paired native end/targeted flush durability. Intent/high-water history is bounded; cold ambiguous outcomes are not automatically replayed.

Public native delete lacks expected-record CAS; the version-pinned internal FIFO seam supplies the missing comparison/write boundary. Native/owner storage still lack a cross-domain transaction and partial writes stay fenced. Cross-session authority/retarget remain unavailable. Completion_output_cap limits closing text in completion notices, not model generation. Caller delivery and proof-gated native continuation preview now use real parent inbox receipts and scheduler_output full readback. Verified cold local teardown-result disagreement now uses the complete tail-free native notice; captured status and failed lifecycle remain separate. Unverified receipt/barrier/store or unknown-format cases retain full notices; universal cap equivalence is not claimed.

Listings use real catalog session binding/status, retain ordinary reminders, enforce 50 rows/24000 UTF-8 JSON bytes and label separate current reads. Native task controls outside adapter creation remain host-owned.
